dialogue.ships: THERE YOU ARE. I WILL LEARN HOW YOU BREAK.
dialogue.cells: YOU BUILT A HOME. NOW I KNOW WHERE TO START.

milestones.line: TEN CELLS. YOUR BORDERS ARE ALREADY TOO THIN.
TWENTY CELLS. EVERY ROUTE BRINGS ME CLOSER.
THIRTY CELLS. I HAVE MORE WAYS INSIDE YOU NOW.
FORTY CELLS. KEEP WATCHING ONE FRONT.
FIFTY CELLS. HALF THIS PLACE IS LEARNING MY SHAPE.
SIXTY CELLS. YOU CANNOT DEFEND WHAT YOU FORGOT.
SEVENTY CELLS. I AM ALREADY BEHIND YOUR LINES.
EIGHTY CELLS. YOUR SAFE PLACES ARE RUNNING OUT.
NINETY CELLS. I WILL TAKE THE REST SLOWLY.
